english.title: Fail to comply with the provisions relating to the loss of a cattle passport / replacement of a cattle passport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[being the keeper of an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), to which a cattle passport related, failed to notify the Secretary of State in writing of the loss, theft or destruction of that passport within 14 days of becoming aware of that loss, theft or destruction]_
(B)_[moved an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), off a holding other than in accordance with paragraph 3(3) of Schedule 3 to the Cattle Identification Regulations 2007, that animal having been the subject of a cattle passport that had been lost, stolen or destroyed and for which a replacement had not been issued by the Secretary of State]_
(C)_[having obtained a replacement cattle passport for an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), and subsequently found its original passport, failed to notify the Secretary of State within 7 days and enclose with the notification the original cattle passport]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 6 and 15 of, and paragraph 3(5) of Schedule 3 to, the Cattle Identification Regulations 2007.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
